text: So my bro and I went here for Devour and they had the 3 course meal with apps, main and dessert. My review is based on the food value. The food is very colorful and vibrant. Nice ambiance and our server was fantastic. So I picked the empanada as my app. This was the best item I had. Nice golden crisp on the outside, flavorful chicken on the inside. It was good, not as bold as my friend's abuelita's empanada but good enough. For my main, I chose the shrimp paella. Looked fantastic. But the rice was a bit dry and hard, as was the shrimp, which was only 3 pieces. It may seem as I'm complaining about the portion but it was actually just right. I just love my skrimps!  She told me it would be spicy and it wasn't.  Then for dessert I chose flan. Pretty good, don't know what to expect since I've never had flan before but it was nice and sweet.  Overall, this was an average dining experience because the flavors did not wow me. But for $20, I guess this was a value dinner? For a downtown restaurant. If I paid more, then this would definitely be below average.

We love the food here!!  Love that it's a small local place!  Burgers are excellent and I'm kind of a burger snob lol!  We ordered a special app on the board the last time we were there-- the Bavarian pretzel- Delish!!  Huge hot fresh pretzel came out hanging from a hook with a beer cheese dipping sauce.  Amazing!  Highly recommend! Oh and my husband said Great Beer Selection as well!!  Lots of craft beer to choose from including some of his local favs
Heard a lot of good things about this place. The busted a la Palomilla was pretty good. Delicious tres leche cake. Friendly staff
The food here is really great, it's bar style food, but a touch fancier. It's a little pricey, but honestly it's good. They're have decent drink selection and the staff are helpful and knowledgeable.
My favorite lunch spot in DTSP. Nothing better than walking down Central to this special place for a recharge.

Fantastic Louisiana food in a casual setting. Wood fired oysters, alligator, pork cheek jambalaya, cochon, and rabbit and dumplings were amazing. Local beers paired great with the food. Service was efficient and friendly. Another go-to fave in NOLA.

We found this place for quick afternoon smoothies and lattes, all excellent! While we were we read the breakfast menu and knew we had to come back. It did not disappoint! The Green Goddess sandwich was amazingly good, the Sammie and Eggspañola were delicious too. We got it for takeout. Everything was perfectly packed, hot and ready when we arrived. All employees wear masks too. Highly recommend!

My family and I had a beyond terrible experience renting the restaurant's Wilmington Hall for my sister's baby shower this morning. The wait staff were very inattentive and could not be found for much of the banquet. I had to go searching outside of the room on several occasions to get the guests drinks and ask that the cake be cut because their was no staff to be found in the actual banquet area. We had to pay in advance for all of the food (understandable) and their was a TON leftover; however, we were told we were not allowed to take any of it with us (ridiculous and not discussed with us beforehand) due to "liability laws". Their liability argument would make sense if it weren't okay to take leftovers home when dining in the actual restaurant. We brought our own cake and asked for boxes to take the remaining home and they were trying to keep us from doing that as well. I had to literally beg to get three small to-go boxes and, when boxing up the cake, the staff finally decided to make an appearance in the way of hovering over us as if we were going to attempt to "steal" the food (we paid for). I asked to speak with the manager several times and, instead, she sent a young member of the wait staff to deliver her "messages". I have never had a more disappointing experienced filled with so much unprofessionalism. I would never recommend Timothy's for banquet services and would never dine here again.

Though it's been around for nearly a decade, I just got around to checking out the Thai Corner Cafe. The layout and vibe is less cafe than "bar with food", with pub height tables, cozy two-seater booths, and a couple expansive "bring the whole gang" booths.
 
There are just over 20 varieties of bottled beer--half of them imports, with no local producers represented. Brewed by Thailand's biggest beermaker, bottles of Singha lager ($9.45, 21oz) and Leo lager ($5.75, 11oz) were served with chilled pint glasses, both reminiscent of American mass-market brews. My younger dining companions chose bubble tea ($4.25 each), one mango, the other honeydew. I've never acquired a taste for the chewy boba balls, but they seemed satisfied with it.

The food menu isn't huge, but has enough stir-fry, curries, and classic Thai dishes to choose from. It's impossible for me to make a first-time visit without ordering fresh spring rolls ($6.95, four pieces) and chicken satay ($8.95, four pieces), whereas the boys can't resist potstickers ($6.95, six pieces). The rice paper rolls were heavily stuffed with lettuce, vermicelli, carrot, cucumber, basil, cilantro, and shrimp, served with a whole lot of agreeably chunky peanut sauce. Large skewers of grilled, marinated chicken were served with just as much sauce, and a rice vinegar cucumber salad. The marinade was sweeter than expected, but worked with the goober goo. The chicken and veggie dumplings were on the small side, but served hot and crispy wit

Absolutely the best local owned restaurant in South Tampa. The family owned business offers the best food at reasonable prices and with the local attention to their food and their customers. This area needs more places and people like Schillers!

4th time back in a week in the same week....it's all so good. Between the apps, I'm torn between the calamari and the chick pea fries. My faves are def the muscles, Industrial burger and the bolognese. Sandy is def one of our favorite severs when we stop in. Can't get enough of this place.

The food is below average and the portions and small. 

Hope they replace this location with a better operator because I live close by and now it's just a waste of space as I'll never return

The food here is high quality, great presentation, and they have a great selection of southern fare. My only complaint was the front of house service was un-energetic and almost non-existent. The bar staff was great, and table service on par. I went there three separate times in a week and that front of house impression needs work, BUT, it's not a show stopper by any means. I still recommend a visit for their deviled eggs, fried pig ears, biscuit sliders and the side of roasted corn and sausage were all fanTAStic! They make a great Old Fashioned as well.
Great spot for breakfast. It's very kid friendly too. The wait is long most of the time but the service is quick and they are very nice.

Function Coffee Labs you are absolutely awesome, I had an incredible experience here yesterday. Function Coffee Labs is a hidden treasure. Nothing but quality. The place was popping but the service was outstanding. Every single thing I had was terrific. I'm giving 5 stars to Function Coffee Labs, only because I cannot give 6 or 7.

My husband and I live super close to Bartaco and we love it! They have such yummy and interesting flavors on their menu. I always bring all of my out of town family and friends to eat here too and they enjoy the food and ambiance. It is also a great restaurant option for anyone with food allergies, like my Mother-in-law who has Celiacs. Favorites are definitely the fried avocado seasonal taco, the pork belly taco, the falafel taco and the guacamole appetizer. The margaritas are delicious too. The meal can get pricey, especially if you are eating with a fairly large group or with people who love to eat- the tacos and portions are small.

The place is best flavored smoothie.  No artificial flavors here. Can really taste fresh squeezed orange juice.  I enjoined being assisted and welcomed with a smile staff.  Was in / out within mins.  Wish they had more locations.  Such a great place.

We went here a while ago, in February, and wow! Excellent food and the service was amazing as well.

You could tell that they take pride in their restaurant because one of the workers was using a flashlight to spot crumbs under a booth! They change the tablecloth after every guest as well. 

The whole place was beautiful, including the windows and bathroom. The staff was helpful too and the place was clean.

Now for the food! 

The entrée we had was garlic bread, but better. It was so yummy, we had seconds! We had the steak and the asparagus and many more. It was delicious!! After every course the employees took your plate (if you were ready, of course). 

Parking was very convenient as it was just down the street and a walking distance. 

Very nice establishment!

Absolutely love this place .... I was turned on to the Red Snapper which is finger licking good. It's is something that you have to order as it is cooked to order. It's definitely worth the wait. And the greens are amazing

I loved my experience here from the service to the food to the location. I live across the river so this is within spitting distance for me. We came here on a date night and opted for the tasting menu. It was a def win. I will warn you though that the portion sizes are on the smaller side. For me that is ok and I am a smaller kind of gal. My partner was a smidge hungry afterwards but the taste of the food was so amazing he didn't complain.

Artists will go gaga over this place. It is extremely creative. I was impressed by the stories behind the dishes and the exquisite plating made it almost a crime to eat it! This is seriously beautiful food. Emphasis on the beauty. The man who is the genius behind this place came out at the end to meet us. He clearly has such a love for his life and it really comes out in his food. He even helped make the pottery you will be eating from. He is completely hands-on and puts all his heart into this art of his. Come give The Butternut Tree a try. You will love it.

Pro Tip: Get a romantic window facing the Leg
This use to be a nice option for a solid buffet every time but it's slipping as Derby Lane prepares to close the end of 2020. Sitting downstairs outside is still a good time though.
Terrible service and food. The potato samosas tasted awful and lacked flavor. My family ordered the $40 karahi gosht which took over an hour to make and it also tasted terrible.

I've never been to the restaurant, but this place has been doing a great job satisfying my sushi cravings during Covid. I've ordered delivery from them a bunch and it's been great every time, highly recommend!
Their food and service is always top notch. They truly take their customers experience seriously!

This place is delicious! Super friendly staff. Easy online ordering. They are taking the necessary precautions for covid-19. People gather at the pickup spot and don't follow the guidelines but that is not something you can control. Overall I love the taste of the food and feel safe picking up food here which I dont feel for many other places.

I have been coming to Shrimp Store for years and have always enjoyed it but after today I will never go back. We ordered our food and the server brought out just one persons order.and we asked about it she got mad and said you will have to pay for that rolled her eyes and continued to tell my daughter that she didn't have time for this. We demanded a manager and all he would do was make excuses stating everyone is just upset by COVID. Our nice lunch was ruined by the staff they were rude and when we left the same waitress tried to start another argument by yelling out "I hope your day gets better. Our day was just fine until we entered the restaurant. I will never eat their again I have never had such horrible service in my life.
Can't beat an original Pho. Would recommend to anyone that is looking for traditional pho.

So glad to finally have a boba place in the Wesely Chapel/Lutz area! After seeing the great reviews I had to check this place out. The service is exceptional. The menu offers various options and the most topping variety I have ever seen. I highly recommend the Artist, it's delicious. The Banh Mi with eggroll is also so flavorful, with a large portion. I highly recommend supporting this local, family business.

First time I had heard of this restaurant was on a ghost tour over three years ago, they said it was haunted and we should take pictures to try and catch a ghost in our photo; I thought this place was a tourist trap. It's not.

The food tastes amazing. I had the onion tart, grilled filet, creme brulee, bread pudding, and a French 75. My friend got the lemonfish, all were fantastic.
Our servers Phillip and Sarah were also wonderful. They were very pleasant, answered all of our questions, and had great suggestions. Waters were filled, plates cleared, we were properly marked, etc. I asked Phillip for a wine taster, and he not only brought me the Chardonnay I was interested in, but also the other, so I could compare.
The balcony has a great view, I wanted bigger tables because we had three drink glasses each, but it actually didn't end up being a problem even with our entree plates.
I think the hostess was training or new, but managers were very present, and everyone had masks and hand sanitizer available.
Hallelujah for being open for dine in during COVID! Our cruise got cancelled for the night and we were worried about our options in the FQ being limited to bars or takeout after getting dressed up. Muriel's honestly saved the day, I'm super happy with how the night turned out.
Love. Love. Love this place!!!!!! If you want a great burrito with some amazing choices of ingredients look no further.
This place was my favorite until I saw all the nasty things they had in the prep of their kitchen. DISAPPOINTED
My husband loves the fully filled cheesesteak and me the variety of pizzas. Every time it's fantastic.

this place is absolutely amazing. everything i've ordered so far was delicious- ice coffee, omelettes, seasonal items, breakfast tacos, EVERYTHING! & customer service is always fantastic. all the hosts and waiters have been super helpful and welcoming!

i always use their yelp waitlist so i don't have to wait super long (they get sooo busy on the weekends).

but yea, if you're on the fence about this place, which idk why you would be lol, just go because it will not disappoint!
Fantastic! Get the Greek's Special, it is a delicious blend of flavors, highly recommended. The antipasto salad is great and big enough to share. The breadsticks are perfect.
Signs say dining room open its BS not 1 table set up only take out not even a " we are sorry" just a ow well such a shame !

I was unimpressed with this meal. I got the Lovebird sandwich with miso-garlic grilled chicken, but I got a significantly smaller chicken cutlet than my friend did and it was underwhelming. The Brussels to the Beet salad was good, but the chicken was pretty dry. My friend ordered popcorn chicken, which was probably the best thing out of this meal. Not sure I'd return though, it's a small place with limited seating.

I've been to about 8 of these in different states and countries and everyone of them had great standards in service and food but this is the first one that both the service and the food were not up to par with this brand.

The food was not the same quality as any of the others, for example the tyko fried chicken was completely burnt to the point where they looked black.  Then the rest of the food were definitely worse than any of the other places I've been to.

Service was basically none existent!  Best example of this is that my grill plates were not changed even once during my entire meal.  Usually they would come by and check if your grill plates needed to be change, but here I was cooking on a completely burnt grill.  Another example is that they did not refill my water for the entire hour and 15 minutes.  All our waters were empty have way thru our sitting as it was a very hot day.

I would not recommend this place as the service and the food does not come close to what this brand represents.

First time eating here and I would have to say the food definitely satisfied my craving. I loved the taste of the hummus and the lamb was not gaming at all. I will definitely be back to order more food in the near future!

Microwaved eggs for my burnt croissant . Microwaved tortilla for the microwaved egg burrito.
Asked for a drink from their menu and they say we don't even know how to make that. Coffee shop gets a 1 star only because it's a nice location. Food is horrible.

We have been in Philly since 1998, back when decent Mexican food was a relative rarity.  Around 2003, things changed for better, especially in South Philly.  I feel like Don Barriga has brought Philly's long awaited Mexican food bounty to West Philly.  The staff are wonderful and friendly.  The food is consistent and delicious.  Shrimp fajitas, burritos, marinated pork tacos, THE NACHOS, the salsas, are consistently great.  Let's keep this restaurant afloat in this COVID mess, neighbors.
Good food fast delivery. Great grubhub deal. The best chinese in town hands down. Thanks

Fresh hot donuts, what's not to like!?

Even the ones that are not hot and ready to go are fresh and delicious.

Although, if you are the kind that prefers a glazed donut (like me) then this is probably not the right place for you, as their donuts are more of just covered in granulated sugar with the flavor of your choosing.
This is not a bad thing, just not for everyone. Even though I prefer a good glazed donut, their version is very good and everyone once in a while you can get their ready-to-Go donuts with a glaze.

If I could give a zero star I would. The first server did not have a clue of what she was doing ordered apps and got the entree first, ordered all flat wings and got drums, ordered sweet potato fries and got regular fries. Ordered brisket and ribs and the brisket was horrible dry cold and I would not feed that to my dog. Bad experience. Will never return to this place and if they don't  implement any changes this place will close soon.

Went to the location on Eagle around 8pm on a weekday.  The Staff was SUPER friendly and treated us mostly like it was a sit-down restaurant. (It wasn't a busy night.  There were only a couple other people eating at that point.) The Burgers were absolutely amazing.  The meat was cooked perfectly.  I wouldn't call myself a burger snob, but I LOVE a good burger.  Anytime I go to a new pub, or any other type of restaurant, I get a burger.  I just love them.  I tried the "Nick Burger" and it was great.  Like I said, the meat was cooked perfectly.  The fixins (avocado, tomato, etc.) were fresh.  It was just a great experience.  I'll definitely be back.  Some complain about waiting for a few minutes to get a high quality burger.  Ummm, that's what makes this place good.....  If you want a super fast burger, go to a Fast Food restaurant.  This is fast casual, so it takes a few minutes more, but absolutely worth it.  

Oh, and their Fries were amazing. They were cooked perfectly, and the fry sauce was perfect.

Why 5 stars? Because I don't think you'll find a better bagel shop in Tampa Bay.

   ---   ---   ---

Admittedly, bagels aren't something I seek out a ton, but after hearing about the greatness of Bagels Plus from my nearby physical therapist for years, I finally made a point to stop in. Turns out, my man is just as good at bagel discernment as is he is getting my back to stop hurting!

My wife and I both opted for a savory and a sweet bagel. Little did we know just how incredibly hearty these bagels were. My lox bagel was absolutely stuffed with cream cheese to the point where it was kind of a mess to eat, but messy things are usually delicious so I was not mad about it. I enjoyed the bagel overall, but thought the real winner was for dessert: the cinnamon raisin bagel with strawberry cream cheese. I was told that the cream cheese is what separates Bagels Plus from the pack and I agree - this cream cheese looked, felt and tasted like it was freshly made this morning and definitely not out of a jar, full of preservatives. I have no idea if that's true, but it certainly seemed that way.

My wife ordered a bacon, egg and cheese bagel and she loved it. I took a bite and was quite jealous of her selection. She opted for her cinnamon raisin bagel to be topped with honey walnut cream cheese, which had a very light flavor to it.

Again, I don't often crave bagels, but this is my new go-to when I do.
Every time I eat here I throughly enjoy my meal. Being from Philly my expectation is always high when it comes to food. Queenshead always hits the mark. YUM

Tried the Krista Krab today on a whim. So good! I did call ahead because other reviewers and the website say each order is made fresh. 20-25 minutes was totally reasonable. I had wanted the blue crabs but they were sold out. My wife and I got the #11 snow crab and garlic oysters. By the time I got there, the order was almost ready. He remembered from the phone I wanted crab, so he advised me next time to try closer to open because they go fast! Their sauce is the bomb! The #11 is snow crab, shrimp, mussels, corn and potatoes. It was delish. I wanted to drive right back and get a 2nd order! He bagged and boxed the food for me so there would be no spills in the car. Try it!

Dined in during August 2020.  This is a great place for eating all varieties of fried chicken - and they have many to choose from.  There are spicy options and non-spicy ones.  There is only a limited selection of sides.  I would consider this to be like a higher quality rendition of Chick-fil-A, Raising Canes, or KFC.  4/5.

This was my first time and boy was i impressed. The building is unassuming  and you might just pass by and miss it. I was visiting  family and wanted to do something different this time. Dont let the wait discourage you. I went twice during our weekend visit.
The Breakfast Salad was delish and the Rice Pudding  was out if this world. The portions are generous. I was so content with my order that i didnt care to share with my husband and either did he. He was impressed  with their pancakes and house coffee. We tried their vegan sausages: spicy. 
All was awesome. We returned and i had my heart set on their organic chicken  sandwich but they had no chicken so i "settled" for the Beet sandwich. Well that was a big surprise! I never thought  i would enjoy  it as much as i did. It had a kick and mimicked  smokey bbq sandwich omg!!! My husband had the Huevo Rancheros  he said the sauce was spicy but very flavorful and filling. 
Being from California  i assumed we were the perfectors of good healthy food. I was wrong.  Thank you 5 Points!!!!
This place is the real deal when it comes to NY style pizza. I recommend the White Pizza with sausage and mushrooms. It is Dreamy!

You can build your own salad with lots of options and be able to have a healthy gluten-free, milk-free lunch.  It was quick enough for us to be able to eat at during our hour lunch break.  Limited outdoor seating so we had to sit inside.

I was excited to have a new local place, as we don't have a lot in Chalfont.  I am originally from Philly, so the menu looked great.   We had the Tomato Pie, Cheese on the Bottom Pie & Buffalo Chicken Pie.  The Tomato Pie was good, but the others not so much.  In fact, almost no difference between the Tomato Pie & Cheese on the Bottom Pie.  Cheese was also hard to find on the Buffalo Pie.  If they did not skimp on the ingredients, would probably be a good place.  They just opened so I may give  them another shot and try their sandwiches.

I experienced Jaggers for the first time today. I ordered two spicy chicken sandwich combos and chocolate chip cookies.  They were very efficient and delivered the food directly to my car wearing a mask and gloves.  No wait at all.  The fries were thin and crispy and the chocolate chip cookie was still hot.  Now let's talk about the chicken sandwich - hands down the best one I've ever had.  Crispy, spicy, juicy and a very large portion.  It came with pepper jack cheese, lettuce, tomato and pickle.  It was delicious.  I wouldn't add or change anything. Sorry no picture to attach.  Check them out !

My boyfriend and i are from New York, visiting Indianapolis for the weekend. i was craving soup...and Yelp brought me here! I'm a huuuge food lover and this place blew me away  the miso ramen was amazing, my boyfriend got the Chinese vegetable noodles...also amazing. The chicken gyoza? best part of our meal. The dipping sauce is sooooo good. 10/10 definitely recommend!

If you are going to try St Louis style pizza then you have to try Pirrone's. PROVEL Cheese! Provel is a delicious. St. Louis favorite! The pizza is one of best in town and they always have lots of great options, hot and fresh I only ordered a cheese pizza that's what I was there for. First of three spots on schedule. This is one locals favorite pizza spots in STL. Awesome service! 100% recommend!

What an amazing experience. This place is phenomenal with great drinks. Food.  Service. Roseann was great she was helpful and friendly.  The wine carafes and liters were huge.  Nice size.  Great soup. We had the yellow split pea. The beet and smoked salmon salad was to die for.  But the true prize was the pate.  So flavorful with ama omg sides. It was the beat thing we ate until. The meatloaf sandwich tied it. The sandwich was soooo good. Soft bread meatloaf that melted in your mouth and a sauce that balanced it so well. We loved the place. Pretty damned cute on the inside.  Nice folks and the chef made an appearance at our table. How courteous.

Rolando the GM and his staff give some of the best service in town. They were incredibly accommodating this evening and I highly recommend this El Charro location. All of the employees were upbeat and friendly, even though we caught them at the end of a long shift. Already looking forward to our próxima visita. ( next visit) 
Five star service

The WORST city view on in the ci- no on the PLANET. All of their chicken is either spoiled or contaminated because the buffalo chicken pizza always leaves you unsettled. Mixed with poor customer service and rude cashiers this needs to be closed compared to the other locations

Best Thai food in the area for sure!  Awesome decor too- the place could be an upscale Ikea catalog lol.

The chicken pineapple fried rice and pad Thai were some of the best that I've had.  A unique smoky flavor, just try it.  The sriracha they have seems to be made in house, and is up there as some of the best hot sauce out there.

They also have daily special desserts that look great.  They had vanilla and chocolate creme brûlée and some macaroons when I went.  Haven't tried them, but I'd imagine they would be good.

Definitely check this place out.  Going to be a biweekly staple for me!
My breakfast was leathery and stale as if made the day or two before and thrown into the microwave. Worst pancakes and bacon I ever had. Will not be back.

Was excited to try this place and decided to place a take out order because I knew it would be a busy night since they had music outside. Got home and found out they didn't give me my side of fries. The brisket burger that came with the side only had spice on one spot and the cheese was not even melted. This made me think the fries weren't worth the walk back. 3 stars for the crispy rolls which were very tasty.

This review is specifically to shout out the amazing Rock Spa! I have been to many full service day spas and this was hands down one of the best. I had the most amazing massage from Antonia! Afterwards, my girlfriends and I hung out in the spa for multiple hours. Jennifer, our spa attendant was INCREDIBLE. We literally told her that if we were ever in the area again, we would book our services around her being our attendant. She was so on point and thought of things we might need before we knew we needed them- that is the definition of amazing customer service. She brought us champagne to celebrate our friends birthday, she got us new robes when ours got wet or it was time for a fresh one, she got us menus to the Pool Bar when she thought we might be hungry or want a cocktail. She even served as  our communication liaison when we were all in different parts of the spa. At the end, after we showered-- she offered us everything we could possibly need to ensure we could get ready as we were heading to dinner! It was a wonderful experience- we asked if we could pack her in our suitcase and bring her home with us, but she loves Tampa too dearly :)
Fantastic! Visiting Nashville and search for breakfast and found Wild Eggs. Potato Head Casserole was out of bounds. Worth a try!

This was absolutely the WORST Chinese food we've ever had (and we lived in Central Florida for 3 years where the Chinese food is bad). For a Philadelphia Chinese place, this is atrocious. 

First, the wonton soup that came with a combination dinner had two wontons in it and the rest was broth. The "crispy noodles" were STALE. The steamed dumplings were extraordinarily bland. Other food that was ordered was chicken with broccoli and shrimp with garlic sauce. 

If you are a foodie, you can tell when a place use good ingredients or not. This was bottom of the barrel ingredients. The food was made cheaply and awful. 

With all of the choices around, this is one to absolutely avoid!

We dined for a girls night out. Two of us in the party are locals and we were suggested this restaurant to take any out of town guests for a wonderful meal. Well this place did not disappoint and exceeded our expectations. I'd give it 6 stars all day long. Half shell oysters were to die for. We ended up ordering another dozen. Cocktails were mixed to perfection. I don't ever get overly excited about places to eat in Reno. Had lots of disappointment in many places suggested as "amazing food". I am so very impressed with Anthony's Chophouse for their excellent service and attention to detail in everything. The cauliflower saffron soup was the best soup I ever had. Cream based but not heavy. Ribeye steak was cooked to perfection. Champagne was perfect pairing with all our meals. Wait staff was very attentive but not over bearing. Also very knowledgeable. I was impressed by our servers ability to talk about the menu in detail. You can tell they prep front of house very well and give them opportunities to taste, sample, and experience the menu so they can communicate with guests and answer questions about the foods selection. I have only amazing things to say about Anthony's Chophouse. This place has just become my number 1 for taking clients, family, and a date night. Highly recommend.

Came here for brunch with friends. I have wanted to try Terrain for awhile after seeing pictures of how pretty it is. The main dining area is in a greenhouse and it's so picturesque with plants all around. We were given bread in a flower pot to start which was adorable. It came with some honey flavored butter I forget the exact type but they were both delicious. They have a lemonade and a tea of the day, I got the lemonade of the day which was also great. For my entree, I had the brioche French toast. This was some of the best French toast I've ever had and tasted more like a dessert honestly. The vanilla mascarpone on it was amazing. My daughter  had the kids avocado toast which was a good portion for a kid.  Everyone in group was happy with their meals. It's pricey here, but not outrageous. Service was a bit slow considering it was a week day. Overall, I enjoyed it and would definitely come back.

Ordered delivery for lunch! I had the vegetable samosa and Mali Kofta and assorted naan. This food is so tasty- it reminds me of the hot out of the kitchen Indian food my friends mom would make growing up! 
The sweet lasi is the perfect way to enhance this lunch and since they deliver to my office I will be ordering again!
Cooks not wear mask over nose, I would think someone would train of the dangers of Covid
Really good, really cheap sushi. Pickup or delivery, either works! Definitely recommend.

I've been coming here for about a year for an egg and cheese sandwich, and I've never once seen a smile or had a polite greeting. It seems like everyone is miserable & no one cares at all about the customer. 
The sandwich had been great so I kept returning. Today there was hardly any egg on the egg&cheese

Wonderful service. Friendly and hospitable. 
Mushroom risotto with perfectly cooked scallops. Duck was also perfectly cooked, although overall the dish was very sweet. 
Great cocktails. Great crab cakes
Amazing food and atmosphere it's tucked into n a shopping center customer service is good

We tried to get a table a couple of times, but the wait was always too long. Today we were lucky enough to only have to wait about 10 or 15 minutes. So worth the wait! We had the mixed vegetables and the cumin lamb. Yum!!! Can't say enough about the flavor and tastiness of both. We'll be back soon.

I found Sundae's through Yelp Roulette in the general direction I was traveling. It is in a shopping center.  When you enter, there are several photos of awards on the wall.  But the ice creeam is what you come here for.  Every flavor is homemade with popular and unique choices such as Peanut Butter Pie, Kit Kat, and Buckeye.  I went with the Peanut Butter Pie shake that is a peanut butter ice cream with a chocolate cookie pie crust.  I got a large and it just wasn't enough.  This was phenomenal ice cream with so many choices. If I am back on the area, I will return for another flavor.
We have only had pick up. Everything is authentic and delicious. Don't try above medium for spicy for your first try. This is a go to pick up spot. The cashew curry chicken is excellent.

We love Panda Express and eat there often.  With us being in quarantine, we were looking forward to their advertised Family Meal Deal and free delivery. I have tried to order delivery through their app for the past hour and it continues to say "no delivery services are available". I have tried calling them for the past hour, and no one is answering the phone. If you are going to advertise a special, you should make sure you can handle the demand. VERY disappointing!

REPLY-Sir, I live 1.5 miles away from the restaurant. This was not a user error.....
Born and raised in NYC this pizza is the best I tasted in Florida. Their delivery was on time personnel was very friend. Wish you were in The Villages.
Ramen was very very good. All fresh ingredients and cooked to perfection. Five stars all day!

I come to this place pretty often for dinner. It has amazing pasta! They offer really good dishes as well as create your own. The price is very reasonable for the quality. Highly recommend for a quick dinner!

Best pizza, waiters and waitresses are super friendly and have a great attitude. Parking can be hard to find depending on the day of the week and the time of day. Always really clean inside and the vibe inside is also great.

I LOVE Tangos! The empanadas are always fresh, never soggy or cold. They are priced fair and are clearly made with quality dough and ingredients. They must clean their fryer oil often and you can taste that in the empanadas. This is our families favorite restaurant in Boise. Hands down. Also, the owner is often there taking orders. He is friendly and inviting. You can tell he cares about his customers experience. We are beyond happy to support this local business. If you haven't tried Tango's, by golly you are missing out!

My favorite empanada is the La Viga with spicy green sauce on the side.
Wait time was 20 min. Burgers where not the quality you would expect, very salty. Fries greasy and salty. Would not recommend.

Drunken Fish has been a massive disappointment recently. This past week, I dropped in for happy hour, and although the place wasn't crowded, I waited more than 20 minutes for service, and even though I kept trying to make eye contact with servers (who were running around frantically), they kept breezing right past me. Eventually, I got up and left and went next door, because I was super frustrated and hungry. Their menu is getting pretty tired, and the decor/interior is started to look dated. I think Drunken Fish would benefit from receiving a major face-lift, design-wise. Just my two cents.

Arrived 1.5 hours before closing on a Saturday night. They were out of brisket, pork, pork steak, ribs. We waited more than 35 minutes for a very simple carry out order of 1 entree and 1 sandwich. Terrible service. Can't tell you about the food because WE ARE STILL WAITING FOR IT!

First time at this Wendy's. First time eating breakfast at Wendy's. The drive thru had about 8 cars in it when I pulled up. I waited about ten minutes until the car in front of me was at the window. There was some issue with their order. The woman in the window helping them was wearing her mask below her nose hanging out of the window. When it was my turn there was a different woman in the window, wearing her mask correctly, and collecting my payment and handing me my breakfast. I ordered a bacon, egg, and cheese biscuit and the seasoned potatoes. I have to say the seasoned potatoes were excellent and might just be the best fast food breakfast potato offering I can think of. They are like a potato wedge French fry and I'm here for it! The biscuit was pretty standard. I'd return if in the mood for this kind of breakfast.

Went through the Arby's drive-through. First off, the lady who was operating the drive-through that was taking her order was speaking so softly we couldn't even hear her. Secondly, they forgot to give us straws for our sodas. Thirdly, the lady messed up on the sodas and miss charged us for a regular soda. It was not the best customer service ever. And probably will never come back to this one ever again.

This was my first time ordering here and I ordered to-go delivery. Delivery said it would take an hour and instead, it arrived in 20-25 minutes. It was fresh and still hot. 

I tried the Pad Thai and spring rolls and I have to say, my Pad Thai was very good. I liked that in the to-go container they separated the ingredients (peanuts, noodles and bean sprouts) so you could mix it together yourself. I've had many Pad Thai dishes and sometimes it has too much going on in the actual dish to really enjoy. 

I was happy with my dinner and happy I gave them a try. I'll definitely be back to try something else.
Hands down the best breakfast taco and salsa verde with avocado in the area. Definitely worth the wait. A must go to if you're in the area. I'm a salsa snob, it had the perfect kick to it.

I usually have a great time when I come, but when it's my friend's 22 birthday and the same bouncer that's been letting her in for a full year denies her because her ID looked "fake" and his boss was right there is bull. Thanks for ruining our night.

The lemon chess pie is OUTSTANDING! I cannot get over how good it is- it's my favorite and reasonably priced. The berry pie is quite good too. They have limited options in terms of gluten free options but you can do a custom order for a gluten free cupcake if you call ahead according to the clerk. Parking is super reasonable and the selection is outstanding! I wish they were open a touch later as I always have to run over quickly after work!

We ordered from here with Uber eats for the first time last night and we will definitely be ordering again!! The food was delicious. We got the Cuban sandwich (which if you get the large is like two whole sandwiches), ham croquettas, tostones, yuca fries, and the tres leches. All of it was amazing!
My favorite breakfast place, anytime I go there I order the country boy breakfast and is always delicious and perfect. Definitely I recommend this place 100%.

Guppy's never disappoints! They always have daily specials from salads to fresh catch! The service is always on point! It's beautiful inside or out! They have fans outside for the Florida heat! Don't miss Guppy's!

The best donairs in the city is all I can say. Super fast and they have tons of workers. I always take to go. The only thing is they don't have enough tables here to sit and eat but I like eating my donair at home.
Great place to meet up for drinks with friends, listen to a live band and watch a sunset. The food is great and you have many options on seating. Can't wait to go back!
Love the mini grilled cheese appetizer and the carnitas quesadilla on the brunch menu. Also had the chicken dinner which was amazing, but the mini grilled cheese..oh man do I crave those!!!
Moderate prices and large, yummy portions. Their eggplant parmigiana and spaghetti bolognese are excellent!

I was visiting a girl friend in Reno and we grabbed takeout. The mixed plate was delicious! The amount of naan we got for what we ordered didn't seem quite right but all of the food was tasty. I imagine their buffet when it can open again would be amazing and move me to 5 stars. The food was ready pretty quickly and was reasonably priced. The Chicken curry and the chicken tikka masala seemed so similar it was hard to taste a difference which seems weird to me but they were tasty. I didn't realize some of it came with rice so that was a fun surprise. I will definitely be eating here again when I come back to Reno. Coming from Union City we have a HUGE Indian population so it is hard to compare to the Indian restaurants here but it was really tasty!

I'm a chipotle advocate but my latest experience at this store was absolutely awful and the manager Jordan treated me terribly. After I called to explain to him what happened, he gave me a fake name. I had an experience where another customer was making me very uncomfortable..taking photos of me and making inappropriate remarks and the staff heard and no one said anything to make me feel okay. The manager just proceeded to tell me that, the remarks I was receiving made his staff uncomfortable and there only teenagers (15-16) that work there so what are they supposed to do? 
I was in shock. I work in customer service and I could not believe that the management here was so inexperienced and awful.
I love the "Cheers" atmosphere in here. Friendly atmosphere, tables to eat, a lounge area to relax and traditional bar. The food is outstanding, haven't had a mediocre meal yet. Plus, strong drinks!

Excellent spot in st Pete beach, right on the beach, we stumbled upon this while on vacation, we had a late breakfast, omelets was great, wife had chocolate chip pancakes which were huge and delicious, highly recommend!! Right on upham beach!!

I had heard so much about the great Walters steak house. A landmark in Wilmington with amazing seafood and steaks. I couldn't have been more disappointed. This may have been a fine dining establishment 20 years ago but, they haven't seemed to made any improvements since that time. We waited 10 minutes before being greeted by a hostess that looked  frazzled and disorganized. quality of our meal.  

We came when there was the complimentary seafood bar. The quality of the seafood was similar to a Chinese buffet, not high quality. The cocktail shrimp were not deveined and the oysters were the lowest quality you could find with a metallic after taste. The serving dish was broken so it snapped back and startled everyone that opened it. 

The restaurant boasts about the quality and flavor of the meats. We ordered the top ones with high expectations.My prime rib was barely warm and had absolutely no flavor.  The filet mignon was not tender at all.  Both the meals came with a Caesar salad that was simply lettuce and croutons, that again, looked like it came from a Chinese buffet. Honestly, the only thing about the restaurant that resembled high quality or fine dining was the check. What a disappointment.

Called in a large supreme pizza - wait time was pretty quick. The staff was extremely friendly, when I walked inside. 

The crust was a nice mixture between hand-tossed and thin crust thickness, and the vegetables were very fresh. 

I'll definitely be trying this place again.
Just a 25 minute ride from Nashville. Their catfish are farm-raised so they doesn't taste like river bottom. Hush puppies were on point. Wait staff was very courteous and attentive.
Current and beautiful website! The restaurant is very clean. the staff is so kind and the food is always delicious. Anything I order comes out great! If you're craving thai, this place is great.

Man I love Evermore so much.  I've been driving coffee all around Philly and this is the best I've found.

When cupping a new roast they try different ratios and brew methods to find the perfect mix to bring out all the notes.

They make wonderful and inventive seasonal drinks.

Place is top notch.

We absolutely love this place! We tried the "other" place in Hendersonville this week. It was awful compared to this restaurant! We highly recommend this especially if you love a boil! Seafood comes out cooked perfect and just the right amount of seasoning and butter to dip in. We recommend the Cajun seasoning. Great job to everyone here. Staff is always friendly!
Food was alright. Tasted like how it was supposed to. Idli was a little flakey but tasted like an idli. A bit expensive but still alright considering there arent any south Indian restaurants in Tampa

I can't even describe the deliciousness of Jockamo's, they always have great service and food. I always do the carry out, and my food is always piping hot, til I get home. They have a great atmosphere in and outside of the restaurant and you should definitely check them out.

This is the closest Chinese restaurant near my home and it really does not disappoint. The positions they serve are really great! Enough to share with someone else. 

I love Lomein so I purchased the small jockey Lomein and oh my gosh it was so much food. Also I normally order the bourbon chicken with pork fried rice combo and again a lot of food and really delicious. 

The service is super fast within 10 minutes they normally have my orders ready. The price is very reasonable and what you would normally pay for Chinese food. 

If you are in the mood for Chinese food and don't feel like cooking at home .. I would for sure recommend.

The sandwiches have gone down in quality and there was no one enforcing safety when a customer decided to remove his mask and eat inside where you were required to wear one. They have a limited menu, but their devilled crabs are superb. I can't wait until covid is over and they go back to full menu.

Reading Terminal Market is such a nice market, but I think we picked the wrong place to have our breakfast.
First all all, they gave us wrong items. They give us all apple cinnamon french toast when we have some regular ones. Why bother to have different choices if you just give everyone the same ones.
They gave our food in Styrofoam boxes. I don't know about Philly. But in NY, no one use that anymore. Save the earth!
I don't know if they want us to have a heart attack or not. Each serving of french toast, they put half a cup of butter in the box. I am not kidding you. HALF A CUP OF BUTTER. I don't think the owner would have want that. How many Costco butter you would have to restock?

Ordered a vegetarian pizza that came with meat on it an hour late after very generous delivery time estimate. 

Ended up paying over 20 bucks for a small greek salad.

Great pasta and salads 

Pizza and service: not so much

Best Cheese Steak and Hoagies in town! 
Doesn't get any better that this! 

Every time I come back home this is the first place I go! 

I Literally get off the plane and get a cheesesteak before I go see the family! Don't even think twice about it either.

Amazing burnt ends! We ordered half a chicken, wings, pulled pork and burnt ends, plus some sides.. by far the cheapest and BEST meal we'd had while visiting the area. Staff was absolutely the most polite people I'd met in a long time, you can tell they really care about their business. I would highly recommend stopping here for great southern BBQ. And the sauce was on point!
The food was fine. The service was good. But they played like 2 Pat Benatar songs, 2 Billy Idle songs and not ONE by Stevie Nick's while we were there. I almost asked to speak to the manager.
Messed up my order and food was subpar.  Those that havent been here aren't missing much.  Capriottis is a nicer alternative.
I ordered ramen for takeout and was super disappointed. Might try them for sushi, but was not impressed by the soup.

The food was ok. Waitress was friendly and professional. My favorite was the guacamole that they make at your table. The food gave me intestinal distress this morning three times so far. Safe to say I will not dine here again.

Max Beach has several kinds of craft beers, and has a great atmosphere! It is very large and has many things to do while enjoying your brew. There food is outstanding! Menu has lots to choose from.....with a good variety!!!

Fantastic food and beers  
I ate 10 minute after ordering 
The Hot Chicken was amazing

Chicken Marsala, came out of the kitchen with a steak-like-knife and a spoon? Ten or so, very tough pieces of chicken about 1/4 to 1/2 inches thick. I always believed it to be more like a sliced chicken breast, with a somewhat thick sauce and sliced mushrooms. The sauce was extremely watery. I noticed a "HELP WANTED" sign for kitchen staff, that should have been my first clue to move on. The server was very pleasant and helpful, no complaint there. This is too nice of a place to have less than average food, I wonder what the Chicken Piccata is like???
Awesome vegetarian vegan options and very delicious, a little on the pricy side for being Tampa but worth a visit!

I had a great experience ordering online and picking up. There were two people in the dining room, socially distanced. The employees were covid-cautious. Everything was clean and safe. 

Addictive truffle fries!!

The tropical chicken salads sandwich here is the best! I've been craving it non stop since I had it last week. They have a lunch special of smoothie and half sandwich for $6.99. The smoothies are huge! I really enjoy the Avacodalata (sp?). Tastes fresh and I even got a few chunks of avocado. Service is always super friendly and smiling!

I was initially very interested in the prospect of having something different and decided to give this place a try. I came in and got some takeout to start. The portions are a little small but the food is tasty... Until you find a piece of metal in your food that nearly breaks your tooth or worse. This is absolutely unacceptable for a new business but the follow up was even worse. I called in to let them know and even sent them a picture to possibly help them figure out the situation. I was told a manager would call me. He called and said he would refund me. I gave him my venmo info as requested and never received anything after weeks.

If you value the safety of your mouth and/or insides, don't go to a place that can't even keep things like this out of your food!

Our first time here and would certainly be our last.

The chicken tatsutaage was so dry and bland, we had to ask for some hot sauce. Much to our surprise, we were charged $0.50 for a tiny cup of Sriracha. This is definitely the first time I was charged for Sriracha, anywhere in the US!

The yakiroti was just a skewer of boiled chicken breast with some sweet sauce on top. This should be GRILLED!

Beware!

My boyfriend and I went here on a trip from out of town. We were craving fish and chips and saw that this place looked good. We wanted brophy bros at first, but they serve the same things with a more casual setting. The seating is basically a free for all but we found some pretty fast. I got a cup of clam chowder and an order of fish and chips. The clam chowder had a HUGE chunks - really yummy. The bread it comes with is so good. The fish and chips were a golden brown and battered pretty heavily, but not overpowering. The fries were a bit salty. We both felt really full after this meal and it wasn't too expensive. The seagulls around are a bit annoying but it comes with the territory. Overall I would go here again if I was craving fish and chips! Love dipping it in the tartare sauce and malt vinegar.

We had a party of 12 for an early dinner recently. They sat us outside which is one of the most beautiful outdoor dining experiences you'll ever have. The service was pretty good and everyone seemed happy with their meals. I had the pork chop and it was great, perfectly cooked. A little pricey but you get what you pay for. We'll be back for brunch some day.
Sad to say but they are closed.  We just had a family lunch last Sat.  Great service & food was really good.

This place is now a disaster zone.  Someone doesn't know what they are doing is running it.   Sunday they are out of food.   No chips no SW egg rolls no bunch of other foods.   The floors were filthy.  The service was extremely slow and spotty.    We got our food really late after an hour of waiting.  And it was just a few of us that got it.   By the time folks finished the other third of the table got their food.   The a little later half way thru the second wave the rest got their food.   Wow just horribly and terribly managed from every angle u look at it.   Avoid at all cost at least until they get new management or something has to change.   We have gone from regulars to never again....yes that bad.
Good meal with a good price! You get large portions for a nice price and calling ahead to order is very easy and quick. The food tastes great, perfect quick stop on my break!
The salmon and the wings are my fav here. I just wish they gave you the option to substitute sides. Also they give you a very small side of Mac and cheese for 6$ they need bigger side cups.

Friendly Tavern- Not so Friendly. We have been there a few times. A couple of times were good but a couple of times were not so good. Just figured they had a couple off days so we came back again. No I've definitely decided that these people are not friendly at all they are rude. The food is not bad the location is OK. Sad to say that the staff is pretty rude to the customers except for the regulars.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. We came here on a Sunday night for date night and were able to reserve one of their private dining rooms - it was fantastic. We had Nicole as our server and she was amazing - so attentive and friendly! Between her and Christian - they made our night! 
On this night I had the sea bass because I had had it a few weeks before and had just been dreaming of it! I got a picture this time but again I love the citrus sauce and the crisped top of the fish - it is a delight! I chose the clam chowder this night and it did not disappoint! The soups here are outstanding especially for someone who doesn't seek out soups. 
I was fortunate that I talked my boyfriend into getting the special that night - which apparently is a Saturday/Sunday thing! It was $65 for a salad, and two courses. His salad was a fun blend of greens and grapefruit - it was a great way to start. The second course was this delicious lamb gnocchi (not pictured). It was AMAZING, the best gnocchi I've ever had and the seasoning was fantastic. The special was worth it just for this dish. But then... the third course came out. It was a steak with grilled carrots. The steak was cooked to perfection, medium rare and the carrots were the perfect compliment.
We finished our night with a key lime tart which was the perfect ending to our meals. 

The ambiance is fantastic, the staff is the best in the business, and the food is to die for! The only bad thing is passing through the s
Solid budget option. Not the best pizza, but not bad at all for the price. The best $9 pizza you can get.

12-19-20
Take Out only during COVID. 
Ordered:
Steamed dumplings -  Absolutely Excellent....loved them plus nicely filled. Excellent sauce too. 
Hot and Sour Soup - Ordered Large - This Soup was SUPERIOR . It tastes 100% perfect filled with mushrooms & all the extras. IT'S A WINNER. 
Szechuan Chicken - Absolutely Excellent. Large serving , plenty of chicken... full flavored plus oh so tasty. I loved it. IT'S A WINNER. 
Service - Young Lady taking order at window was very pleasant and EXCELLENT. 
I highly recommend this Chinese Restaurant!!
I can't wait to return

Very good soup, with a wonderful variety. Their black bean soup, and thai soup, so good. The friendly staff got an order wrong once, but luckily it was another vegetarian option, and it was still tasty - so I didn't mind. Hunker down and warm up with their fresh ingredients and side options like slaws and pickled veggies - and freshly baked bread! They have a wonderful and cozy outdoor area.  I will return often.

Good food but never consistent- one day its completely different than the next & though I have enjoyed it all, the inconsistency is deal breaker- it's a shame, hope they are able to streamline bc it's tasty food & would love to support locals

Cinder House is a great place with an awesome roof top that has a pretty darn good view. Place has a big outdoor space so you aren't close to anyone.

Definitely recommend the wings and the filet. They were pretty darn good. Great service, very friendly staff especially when we asked a bunch of questions in regards to renting the space and other things. Thanks for the hospitality!

Boom. If any out-of-town guests visit me and they like barbecue this is the place I bring them to. I love the ribs and brisket, my kids love the burger with the come back sauce! Fries and broccoli salad are incredible sides.

Half price Sushi on a Sunday? Yeah, it caught my attention too! 

(with the purchase of a beverage, but nonetheless still a great deal) 

We were seated right away although it was around 9:20PM when we arrived. It was still very busy inside and a little loud as well, but there was still plenty of sushi coming out of the kitchen! 

We ordered 3 rolls: Mount Fuji, Spider and the Forty-Five. The Mount Fuji was so so so good and creatively they were all stacked upon one another. The Spider was another favorite of mine and is always a solid choice if you don't know what to order. I was really excited about the Forty-Five, but it was honestly a super boring roll and relatively bland - I would take a detour on this one! 

Overall, the menu is pretty pricey, but for half price it is well worth it to skip the delivery fee and make the trip there to enjoy some really quality sushi!

We had Elizabeth as our waitress and she was straightforward with us that it was her first day working. She clearly must have experience in the restaurant business because this was one of the best experiences I've had. Recommendations were great and the food was amazing. Will definitely come back next time we are in St. Louis!
Great selection of items. The only place nearby I could find golden hominy corn. Sorry for buying so many! None of the other Latin stores around me ever have any.

I have not been to this place in person but I have ordered them several times on Door Dash, so this review is only for their food. It is delicious. 

I have ordered their pizza, pasta and deserts and it is excellent. It is always consistent and good and decent portion sizes. They have a Sicilian pizza which is cooked perfectly and their Grandma pizza is really tasty. The Alfredo is so thick and I could tell it was very fresh. 

I highly recommend you try this place!

Excellent!   Love this place!   My brother and I ordered ribs and brisket.   Both were delicious!!  Also I ordered "fire and ice" pickles which were delicious too
I can't wait to go back!!

I went here while visiting my best friend who lives in Tampa and it is beautiful! We did the tour and got taken around the winery on a buggy like tractor thing. It was a lot of fun! Then we got a little history lesson on how they became a winery and how it is made. After we went back to the bar and had a cider flight and wine tastings. Their wines are amazing!! I bought three back home with me to Miami. I liked the peach and wild berry the best.

My boyfriend and I met with some of his co-workers on a Saturday night.  There was 7 of us. We all ordered our dinner and waited quite awhile. It was about an hour. But it was worth the wait though.

We had the Samosa Chaat as an appetizer. This appetizer was sooooooooooooo good. I would highly recommend this appetizer! We also ordered some Butter Naan and it was good. 

For our main entree, we had ordered a goat dish: Shinwari Karahi. We decided to share this but next time I'm going to order my own. This dish was amazing and it was so flavorful.  I highly would recommend this dish. I definitely would order this again!

It is pretty hard to ignore the glaring 'Best Chinese Restaurant in New Jersey' banner that hangs proudly on the front of this restaurant. At first it seems a tab but braggadocious but it certainly stoked a certain level of curiosity and  giving in to that I decided to check this place out.

The set up if this place is 'classic' in that it feels like typical Chinese take out place but with better seating. The staff however are so inviting and welcoming that seems to take away from the somewhat lackluster feel of the inside of this restaurant.

The food however which is what is the driving force of this restaurant is in no way 'classic'. The sing in the front more than delivers, this is easily the best Chinese food i have had. 

And this is where the review ends because I started this review 3 years ago and I don't seem to remember a lot to write an honest review. Oh i remember this though. Do not have the rabbit (the waitress told me that)

This place is open seasonally as it is a family run business that coincides with their crops. The Works desert is absolutely amazing! It's not your mommas strawberry shortcake that is for sure! They also have a really good Cuban Sandwhich! While eating their delicious food make sure to pick up some organic, locally grown fruits, veggies, and products.
